Gideon, here's a draft from #inc-vtg-hartford. I haven't emailed it to anyone.

**Hartford gate kiosk incident, 3 Aug 2026**

- **First report:** 10:42 AM. Both inbound lanes at Vantorre's Hartford plant showed a white screen after badge scan. Scheduling from the dispatch office was not affected. The guard logged trailers on paper in the meantime.
- **Kiosk 1 restored:** 11:03 AM. Mateo confirmed the guard checked in trailer 8836 and dispatch could see it.
- **Both lanes confirmed working:** 11:07 AM, posted at 11:08 AM. We kept the incident open for one more arrival cycle.
- **Still open:** Mateo's account can't see the status page. That is tracked as a separate issue under INC-4821.

All times are as posted in the channel. They don't say which time zone, so I assume local Hartford time. Please confirm that before it goes out. The channel also doesn't give a root cause, so I left that out.

If you send this to Mateo at Vantorre, that is an outside address. Ruth Calloway has to approve any outside mail, even a draft. Tell me if you want me to ask her.
